text: In the last few months it's really gone down hill. With every update the game gets worse. It's almost impossible to get bingos now. Side games can't be completed. Albums are getting harder to complete. To top it off, they've just changed the exchange rules without warning, and suspended the Facebook community trading pages a couple of days before the trade because they knew people would complain! Don't get this game. It's impossible to play without spending money and it's so expensive!!

I was really enjoying this game and I've spent a lot of money. But since the latest update, I am not having fun at all, a single bingo is a rare thing now, so I can only play a couple before I'm out of tickets. I definitely won't be spending anymore as the tickets disappear within minutes, so it's no longer worth it. The mini side games used to be a great way to get extra rewards, I used to be able to get everything in the reward shop, now I can barely finish the bottom row.

I used to love this game! Played everyday and even spent the odd quid on good deals! But suddenly, it's been changed and it is now almost IMPOSSIBLE to get a bingo let alone progress, unless of course you pay money! You wait all day for your tickets to stack up and you are lucky to get one game with four cards, not even maxed out cards, and even luckier to get a bingo. I have a number of times got 1-2k tickets from one game, or at least I used to! Totally fixed now and I'm not going to bother!

used to love it. now hate it. getting even a single bingo is extremely difficult. there's an average limit on how many of your numbers will get called and 9/10 you'll only have 1 on a single card called, rendering the power ups useless. completing levels takes weeks due to lack of wins, plus once you get down to your last ingredient, it's rare they come up which further slows progression in the game. I've never completed a sticker album despite always getting extremely close. 1/10 rating.

don't play unless you plan to pay. As expected, it's like every other app that let's you play until you run out and then it throws purchase options in your face repeatedly. Events lasting only 24 hours, and yes there are free ways to play if you only plan on playing 1-3 games per day. It's fun at first, you can win a lot, but after a bit, it gets difficult to earn anything or even win. You can run 4 cards and get a bingo on each, but only win back 1/4 of what you paid. doesn't make sense

There's a few things I dislike. When calling balls for the team cards, there are lots of duplicates. I've called 5 balls and had 2 sets of duplicates from just those. You use a lot of power ups, a huge amount so you're constantly looking for more. Regularly get told I've got connection issues but my Wifi is good strength. That said, I still play, and for now I will continue, but I hope there are improvements made.

Firstly, this game has fantastic graphics and a great concept which would have kept me hooked. However, the rewards (compared to the cost of playing) are an insult. There are so many useless duplicates and you fail the majority of the time. It is almost impossible to progress. If you want to lose a lot of potential players then run your app like this. If they fix the rewards or make it possible to trade cards and ingredients more often. Then I might play again but otherwise this a bad app.

It's a fun game but I started it as an offer off of Prime Opinion. I was getting my rewards and once I got to the higher paying levels, I stopped getting rewards. And the game does not provide a link to submit a ticket. and if I get an answer, it is generic and gives me instructions that are not useful. I am owed over 2500 in points and the whole process has been a complete waste of time.

Been playing this for a while and it's sadly feeling like to get the best items you have to pay. And in the last month they've put massive price hikes in on some parts that no longer make it enticing. I also feel they are getting more pushy with the sale notifications. I worry for the future of the game, would have given it higher had all the recent changes really put me off.

I just downloaded this game & so far I'm impressed! Lots of free play & extras. You can play up to 4 cards, with multiple Bingo's per card. The graphics are nice, too. Negatives include the fact that power-ups tend to run out fast & u usually spend more per game than u win, unless u get multiple Bingos. Overall, it's fun though, and I'd recommend it over lots of the other Bingo games on the Play Store.

My favorite thing about this game is when you hit a bingo, you at best will break even with the amount it cost to buy the card. I have ran out of tickets so many times I can't even count. Out of all the ways they could make money on this game they literally make it not playable by completely taking your option to play away. People spend the money on games to reach achievements not just to play the game in general. Imagine if bingo in real life was like this it would disappear with a quickness.

I have been using this app for a while and enjoy playing it. However, over the last few days almost every time I watch a video to gain cards, tickets, power ups etc. It will automatically either go to the app store/website of the add or throw me out of the game totally. Have given up for the day now. You know what they say 'when the fun stops, stop'

I actually really enjoy this game, graphically its cute, smooth and plays well, the music tracks during the game are nice. Also having spent money I think both the free and paid for rewards are very well though out. my only gripe and or concern is my larger wins seem to ONLY happen shortly or directly after a purchase, and when playing on days I havent made a purchase I maybe bingo once or twice and theres a definite pattern of loses to push you to wait until the next day. slightly suspicious.

downgrading my review from 5 to 1 stars. been playing this for 4 years. has gone from being VERY generous with rewards in the beginning to down and down and down more... to the latest update (apr 24) where what was already crazy low rewards were cut in half again! spent 8k tickets to play pet side game and STILL it enough pieces to complete 1 pet (3 months ago I completed 36 pets, btw). I used to spend about $200/month playing. never spending another penny. they say random. I call nonsense.

The recent update changed the login reward to 'miss a day and start over', which is a bad change and makes it very hard to get the one 5 star card pack that was guaranteed for f2p players. I was motivated to log in almost every day because I liked the game, 'forcing' players to log in every day to not lose their streak makes me wanna play less instead. This was a fun game and playable without spending money, if you don't care about completing everything but just want to play some bingo cards.

Okay I absolutely love this game but sometimes the lack of tickets is super frustrating. I mean once u lose them all its hard to get any back. I watch the ads that bearly allow to pay for 1 ticket. Then because I was to create dishes, I spend more tickets, lose them and now I'm stuck with no tickets all day. Its a shame when all I wanna do is continue playing game after game and try and make the special dishes (which are hard and more expensive). Overall I haven't deleted yet because I enjoy it.

In the beginning it was fun . As you start progressing the levels become very difficult and bingos are unachievable. They randomly announce trade days and make rules without informing. They want people to buy but you get all duplicate cards. You have added to our stress. Customer support is not at all helpful. Without multiple spending, it's difficult to complete the album . Disappointed.

Fun but designed to spend money! The games cost too many ticket and the pay outs are terrible! I've got multiple Bingos on several cards and still didn't earn back all the tickets it takes to play a round. Even the purchases don't give enough to be able to keep playing consistently. I don't mind spending some money here and there but it needs to be worth it. I'll be finding another Bingo app!

It used to be a lot of fun until they got greedy. They plugged AI or something into it in order to maximize their profits and squeeze every dime they can out of you while absolutely screwing you over. They keep making it harder and harder to play for free. They constantly change the rules of the game without notifying you. They make it impossible to complete your card albums without you having to throw money at it. They charge different players different prices for the in game ticket packs.

Don't start this game because you're just going to end up pissed off and frustrated because after you've been playing the game for like a couple of levels everything changes. bingo frenzy has made it impossible to play this game because there is an algorithm in the game that makes it so you can't win after you've been playing for a short time. and now they've made changes just this week, that basically make it impossible to get ahead. Don't start playing trust me.

The game is nice, nice animations, maybe the best from this area, i even invested some money, but. A big BUT: the game is 100% scripted, even the side games. There is nothing related to luck, as it should be in a bingo game.( for example, that snake game: 6 times in a row to land on the snake at the final stage. Mathematically, it's impossible. ). All for profits. You forgot one thing: there are plenty of bingo games out there,

Would be fun, but tickets are hard to come by, packs don't have much value, and no point in spending because it goes too fast to add any fun or value. I liked the game itself, but it's boring when you can only play a couple games, then you have to spend or quit playing for the day. It's only a cash grab with games now, and there isn't enough value in "cash grab" packs to be worth it

I absolutely love this game and have played for years. I would love to give it 5 stars but the new updates make it harder to level and play side games with the new ticket system. When you make it cost soo much each round just to be able to play side games and team events it definitely losses its appeal to play. The rooms and side games are great. Working with my team is fun and relaxing. Maybe if I were a newcomer the new updates wouldn't be so frustrating. It really is fun to play though.

Love a good scam? Bingo Frenzy is just for you! This game is super fun & built incredibly well but the more you move up the more you lose! They'll call 20 numbers and none of them will be yours. Games go from not costing 20-100 tickets and then out of nowhere 500 tickets per game, which you'll absolutely lose. No matter how many power ups you've got, they will take your diamonds instead. Then if you buy more, you'll lose it instantly. Leveling up in any capacity makes it impossible to win. Don't

Fun game for like 3 days, at first you"ll be winning a lot (by design). Later on, it impossible to win more tickets than you spend, i played for 2 days, not a single time i won positive tickets. Only decent way to get more tickets, of course to buy it, so i just deleted the game, i would rather pay once for a game, than to spend more and more money so you can just play it

You will only be able to play for a few minutes a day, as there is no consistent way to refill your tickets for multiple games without spending money, even if you wait over the course of 24 hours. The app constantly bombards your screen to try and get you to make purchases with real money. Every single aspect of the game seems to be designed to slowly bleed you until you either pay them money or quit.

I have been playing this game since 2020. I 've gone through all the ups and downs with changes over the years. Most of them work out in the end. This is honestly my favorite bingo game. I have to mention the most recent changes have made everyone who plays daily want to quit the game completely. Most of us dont mind spending money, but as soon as you do, you start losing. The price of packages get higher the higher your VIP level. (unaffordable) It's also harder to complete any special events.

DON'T DOWNLOAD THIS!! EXPEN$IVE!! Used to be fun but Vertex has gotten GREEDY. They say you can play without paying, but you can't. Impossible to complete album games when they limit the cards needed to complete it. Games rarely win & they consistently want $19, $29, to over $100 for items, power upside & bonuses. Long-time players are leaving in droves because it's no longer fun. Find another Bingo game - this one now sucks & they have absolutely no respect for their players.

I gave this game three stars for one reason: it's pay to play. Within the first week, I got to a point where I had to buy game tickets. The alternative is to wait several days to accrue enough free tickets to play, and it would have only been enough for one low reward two card game. It's disappointing because I really like Bingo and would happily spend a little money now and then, but I'm not spending money every day to play. Pros: The graphics are good and the side quests are interesting.

Like all other bingo apps, you have to pay to play after the first couple of days because you can't ever win a bingo and you don't get enough tickets back to play again when you do. I had Google play credits and "bought" a package and then lost every ticket in less than 10 minutes. Very frustrating game play when 120 bingos go and you haven't gotten a number called in 10 balls with 4+ cards. Update, it's worse. I fall asleep waiting for a single number of mine to be called every single night.

Was not a bad game over all with the acception of everyone needing the same cards at the end of the season and not enough cards to go around. And now my wife's game doesn't allow her to purchase anything in game so instead of adding the final star from 4, I'm taking away 2 stars and now 1 more gone for thinking about yourselves making money and not responding or not improving the game and making it more difficultfor the players....

still 5 stars however..Ive been playing on and off since Jan 2021, I love it, when the game starts being inconsistent, I log off for a few weeks, then back again. I've noticed that its becoming harder to play. cost of tickets for the events minimum 24k, the wins have been few and far between and horrible disconnect, pack cost is too high now, i still love it, love the community of the game, my club has some pretty amazing ppl, lots of events, lots of neat things to do, new stuff popping up.

This game has such an unbelievably stupid design philosophy. If you keep winning, you get to play more. If you lose, or worse go on a losing streak, you don't get to play for quite a long time. If you don't want me to play your game then I won't. Glad we understand each other. edit: for reference, it takes me 60 tickets to /possibly/ make the bare minimum amount of progress. I only get 7 tickets an hour. This is just pathetic and frankly unacceptable.

Don't waste your time downloading this game. You'll win initially and then it's downhill from there, you need a Miracle to win!!!!

A generous game builds loyal players, while a greedy one drives them away. I hope you choose to make Bingo Frenzy fun again. Reward players fairly, and everyone wins together

Love this bingo! Play to level up or not, your choice! Lots of bonus games to for tickets and power ups. Graphics are fun and incredibly easy. Option to purchase more tickets at very reasonable price. An absolute must for Bingo lovers!
